column2: [intro]
In my room, it’s quite a show,
A real mess, and it's far from slow.
Socks hiding under my bed,
And books that have fled and spread.
The mess tells its own tale,
In this chaos, life’s a gale.
Lost items and secrets well-played,
In this jumble, anything’s made.
My closet’s a real cluttered dream,
Clothes in a chaotic scheme.
My dress hides behind my pajamas,
What a funny scene, what a grand drama!
The mess tells its own tale,
In this chaos, life’s a gale.
Lost items and secrets well-played,
In this jumble, anything’s made.
